natural_language: Create a bar chart to visualize the count of prescriptions for each drug type.
dvq: Visualize BAR SELECT DRUG_TYPE, count(*) FROM PRESCRIPTIONS GROUP BY DRUG_TYPE
sql: SELECT DRUG_TYPE, count(*) FROM PRESCRIPTIONS GROUP BY DRUG_TYPE

natural_language: Create a line chart to show the count of unique subjects of different ages diagnosed with chest pain.
dvq: Visualize LINE SELECT AGE, COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_ID) FROM DEMOGRAPHIC WHERE DIAGNOSIS = 'CHEST PAIN' GROUP BY AGE ORDER BY AGE
sql: SELECT AGE, COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_ID) FROM DEMOGRAPHIC WHERE DIAGNOSIS = 'CHEST PAIN' GROUP BY AGE ORDER BY AGE

natural_language: Create a scatter plot showing the number of distinct subjects admitted each year, ordered by admission year.
dvq: Visualize SCATTER SELECT ADMITYEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_ID) FROM DEMOGRAPHIC GROUP BY ADMITYEAR ORDER BY ADMITYEAR
sql: SELECT ADMITYEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_ID) FROM DEMOGRAPHIC GROUP BY ADMITYEAR ORDER BY ADMITYEAR

natural_language: Create a pie chart to show the count of prescriptions by route for the drug Simethicone.
dvq: Visualize PIE SELECT ROUTE, COUNT(*) FROM PRESCRIPTIONS WHERE DRUG = 'Simethicone' GROUP BY ROUTE
sql: SELECT ROUTE, COUNT(*) FROM PRESCRIPTIONS WHERE DRUG = 'Simethicone' GROUP BY ROUTE

natural_language: Create a bar chart to display the count of distinct subjects by gender for those diagnosed with 'Other and unspecified coagulation defects' and received 'ADDITIVE' drug types.
dvq: Visualize BAR SELECT DEMOGRAPHIC.GENDER, COUNT(DISTINCT DEMOGRAPHIC.SUBJECT_ID) FROM DEMOGRAPHIC INNER JOIN DIAGNOSES on DEMOGRAPHIC.HADM_ID = DIAGNOSES.HADM_ID INNER JOIN PRESCRIPTIONS on DEMOGRAPHIC.HADM_ID = PRESCRIPTIONS.HADM_ID WHERE DIAGNOSES.LONG_TITLE = 'Other and unspecified coagulation defects' AND PRESCRIPTIONS.DRUG_TYPE = 'ADDITIVE' GROUP BY DEMOGRAPHIC.GENDER
sql: SELECT DEMOGRAPHIC.GENDER, COUNT(DISTINCT DEMOGRAPHIC.SUBJECT_ID) FROM DEMOGRAPHIC INNER JOIN DIAGNOSES on DEMOGRAPHIC.HADM_ID = DIAGNOSES.HADM_ID INNER JOIN PRESCRIPTIONS on DEMOGRAPHIC.HADM_ID = PRESCRIPTIONS.HADM_ID WHERE DIAGNOSES.LONG_TITLE = 'Other and unspecified coagulation defects' AND PRESCRIPTIONS.DRUG_TYPE = 'ADDITIVE' GROUP BY DEMOGRAPHIC.GENDER

natural_language: Create a line chart to display the number of unique patients prescribed 'Potassium Phosphate' for stays longer than 17 days, grouped and ordered by the length of stay.
dvq: Visualize LINE SELECT DAYS_STAY, COUNT(DISTINCT DEMOGRAPHIC.SUBJECT_ID) FROM DEMOGRAPHIC INNER JOIN PRESCRIPTIONS ON DEMOGRAPHIC.HADM_ID = PRESCRIPTIONS.HADM_ID WHERE DAYS_STAY > 17 AND DRUG = 'Potassium Phosphate' GROUP BY DAYS_STAY ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT DEMOGRAPHIC.SUBJECT_ID) DESC
sql: SELECT DAYS_STAY, COUNT(DISTINCT DEMOGRAPHIC.SUBJECT_ID) FROM DEMOGRAPHIC INNER JOIN PRESCRIPTIONS ON DEMOGRAPHIC.HADM_ID = PRESCRIPTIONS.HADM_ID WHERE DAYS_STAY > 17 AND DRUG = 'Potassium Phosphate' GROUP BY DAYS_STAY ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT DEMOGRAPHIC.SUBJECT_ID) DESC

natural_language: Generate a scatter plot to display the count of unique patients by admission year before 2190 with abnormal lab results.
dvq: Visualize SCATTER SELECT ADMITYEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT DEMOGRAPHIC.SUBJECT_ID) FROM DEMOGRAPHIC INNER JOIN LAB ON DEMOGRAPHIC.HADM_ID = LAB.HADM_ID WHERE DEMOGRAPHIC.ADMITYEAR < 2190 AND LAB.FLAG = 'abnormal' GROUP BY ADMITYEAR ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT DEMOGRAPHIC.SUBJECT_ID) DESC
sql: SELECT ADMITYEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT DEMOGRAPHIC.SUBJECT_ID) FROM DEMOGRAPHIC INNER JOIN LAB ON DEMOGRAPHIC.HADM_ID = LAB.HADM_ID WHERE DEMOGRAPHIC.ADMITYEAR < 2190 AND LAB.FLAG = 'abnormal' GROUP BY ADMITYEAR ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT DEMOGRAPHIC.SUBJECT_ID) DESC

natural_language: Create a pie chart showing the count of unique subjects of each gender who have been diagnosed with Candidal esophagitis and have an abnormal lab result.
dvq: Visualize PIE SELECT DEMOGRAPHIC.GENDER, COUNT(DISTINCT DEMOGRAPHIC.SUBJECT_ID) FROM DEMOGRAPHIC INNER JOIN DIAGNOSES on DEMOGRAPHIC.HADM_ID = DIAGNOSES.HADM_ID INNER JOIN LAB on DEMOGRAPHIC.HADM_ID = LAB.HADM_ID WHERE DIAGNOSES.LONG_TITLE = 'Candidal esophagitis' AND LAB.FLAG = 'abnormal' GROUP BY DEMOGRAPHIC.GENDER
sql: SELECT DEMOGRAPHIC.GENDER, COUNT(DISTINCT DEMOGRAPHIC.SUBJECT_ID) FROM DEMOGRAPHIC INNER JOIN DIAGNOSES on DEMOGRAPHIC.HADM_ID = DIAGNOSES.HADM_ID INNER JOIN LAB on DEMOGRAPHIC.HADM_ID = LAB.HADM_ID WHERE DIAGNOSES.LONG_TITLE = 'Candidal esophagitis' AND LAB.FLAG = 'abnormal' GROUP BY DEMOGRAPHIC.GENDER
